notes: The kept set spans tumour-informed, whole-genome and methylation-based MRD (CRC, NSCLC, breast, bladder via urine and plasma, viral EBV and HPV ctDNA), fragmentomics (end motifs, fragment-end positions, cell-type signatures, repeat landscapes, genome-wide mutation profiles, targeted-panel fragmentomics), methylation and epigenomic tissue-of-origin and subtyping, multi-cancer and single-cancer early detection, tumour-fraction and genotyping landscapes (fusions, CHIP, CSF), and non-oncology cfDNA and cfRNA (kidney transplant, preeclampsia, prenatal screening, tuberculosis). It lacks sepsis and metagenomic infection cfDNA beyond tuberculosis, mechanistic cfDNA-biology work (nucleases, clearance, release), and oncology MRD and NSCLC remain overrepresented because the shortlist is dominated by clinical-journal ctDNA papers. Two ctDNA-guided trials (BR.36, DYNAMIC) and one clinical-radiomic-fragmentomic model (clinic-RadmC) are kept as borderline at the end of the list, because the ctDNA measurement is the object of study rather than incidental.
